senses.gloss: f. (v. חָשַׁךְ I Hif.) awaiting the nightfall (on the Sabbath), approaching the Sabbath limit in day-time and waiting there for the night for the transaction of business.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 151a:1">Sabb. 151ᵃ</cite> <he>רשאי אני בחֲשִׁיכָתוֹ</he> (Mish. <he>להחשיך עליו</he>) I am permitted to take the preliminary steps for it before nightfall.
